title: Crazy mall world dream last night
content: Hey y’all, I’ve been running on less sleep and stress due to work, resulting in some crazy dreams over the weekend. Last night, I dreamed of a new apartment. It mirrors my current apartment IRL. But I’m this apartment, there were a few doors and places that didn’t exist in my normal one. So it basically started off like my husband and I moving in to the apartment. As in many dreams, the previous tenants left behind a ton of crap in the cub boards, this time there was animals left behind. We noticed a couple dogs and a couple cats. Further exploration lead to an attic. This is where shit gets kind of wild…as we went up the attic stairs we noticed an unfinished space-think rafters and wooden beams. There were 2 babies and several cats and dogs running around! We looked up further and saw an entrance that said “Parish Cresh” it was actually a church daycare. Our apartment was attached to an old church! I walked in and looked around and saw the people from Righteous Gemstones painted on the walls. It was a huge room with detailed paintings, like a big church room basically. The NPC church people were like what are you doing here? I woke up after that, but it was really quite the mall world dream. New places are being unlocked every week.
